issues.location: Inherited commerce.package interior V endpoints, center vertical bottom, 20/24 top tape endpoints
issues.description: Interior strokes end at original vertices and their caps protrude past the painted perimeter; sharp shows small nails at left/right top corners and bottom. Rounded perimeter no longer goes through the original vertex, so changing only cap style may not fully solve the bottom contact.
issues.suggestion: Refine package mother geometry. Intersect painted interior strokes with the actual closed box silhouette before combining with the perimeter, or shorten endpoints to the actual rounded tangent boundary. Preserve structural joins rather than inserting knockout gaps. Recheck base package and dependent package-check/return after the shared fix.

resolution.observation: 內線墨跡限制於箱體實際剪影後，sharp頂角與底角凸釘消失，rounded底部不再突出；內線與外框仍相接而非新增knockout縫。兩個狀態的前景淨空沒有新碎屑。
